newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade leaps, Unibanka stable. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade leaps, Unibanka stable. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]

text.p: Trade on the Latvian stock exchange leapt on Tuesday but leading share Unibanka was stable, the Riga Stock Exchange said.
Overall market turnover was 67,769 lats, compared with 34,547 lats at the last market session.
Unibanka was unchanged at 1.94 lats and trade in its shares came to 37,694 lats.

Riga Transport Fleet, the other share on the official list, also showed good activity at 18,051 lats but its shares rose slightly to 85 santimes from 82 santimes. (Corrects direction of share movement)
Shares on the secondary market list showed good activity.
The Kaija fish cannery was the busiest at trade of 5,590 lats and its shares climbed to 50 santimes from 44 santimes. (Corrects direction of share movement)
Transport group Vitransauto turned over 2,380 lats of stock and ended slightly lower at 34 santimes versus 36 santimes. (Corrects direction of share movement)
The Latvijas Tilti construction group had volume of 2,300 lats and its stock price was stable at 46 santimes.
Shares in Mangali Shipyard added (corrects from "lost") one santime to 25 santimes with volume worth 1,300 lats.
